title: test(runtime): reuse the census transports, pay first boots at module scope, and declare two budgets (#23181 slice 19)

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWbd6ULfZV9gLaW3DrBhtG4)_

Part of #23181 (slice 19, `@objectstack/runtime`). The card is a series and stays open.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Test-only diff: `skip-changeset`. Three files under `packages/runtime/src/`, all `*.test.ts`; `@objectstack/runtime`'s `files[]` ships `dist` only.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:runtime 包 3 个测试文件。`meta-list-projection-parity` 的普查用例改为每个调用者复用一对已启动的 dispatcher/RestServer;`mcp-package-object-discovery` 在模块顶层先付两种形态的首次启动;它和 `stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin` 在第 2 行加 `// test-budget:` 声明。只动测试文件。
- 为什么改:卡 #23181 要求单个测试文件不超过 10 s;这三个文件在最近一次计时刷新里分别是 13.60、14.93、16.31 s。
- 风险与回滚:不改断言、超时与分层;复用前后 6,136 次读取逐字节一致(一次性证明,见下);整包 8,834 个用例名前后一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` 的 `censusPair`(复用的依据写在注释里);`mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts` 第 2 行与模块顶层预热那一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`,预期 879 个用例全绿,文件耗时约为 main 上的一半。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The newest per-file reading is the weekly shard-timings refresh of 2026-10-26 (job 121418010419 in run 40275747937, refresh PR #25960's window, hourly runs 40200279306 to 40272142430); no refresh has run since. It lists three `@objectstack/runtime` files over 10 s: `src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts` 16.31 s, `src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts` 14.93 s and `src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` (repo project) 13.60 s, all in run 40200279306. The card's two older runtime rows, `src/declared-capability-absence-warn-once.test.ts` and `src/stored-metadata-body-boundary.pin.test.ts`, are not in that list and read 0.1 s and 3.7 s here, so this slice leaves them alone.

**Fixture reuse: `meta-list-projection-parity`.** Its four census blocks (row A, the item read, the layered route, the book tree) booted a fresh dispatcher and a fresh `RestServer` (with its `registerRoutes()`) for every caller of every cell. The file booted a dispatcher 3,179 times, nearly all in these blocks, and a `RestServer` as often; in one instrumented run the boots took 1.53 s (`RestServer`) and 0.42 s (dispatcher) of a 3.73 s file. They now read through one pair per caller (`censusPair`), booted on its first cell. Neither transport keeps an answer between two GET reads (`RestServer`'s `execCtxMemo` is a `WeakMap` keyed on the request object; the dispatcher's `membershipCache` is keyed on an environment no read here names), and every protocol-double read clones its fixture. The blocks that assert on a double's calls, or boot with options, still boot their own.

**Module-scope first boots: `mcp-package-object-discovery`.** Each shape's first kernel boot was its slow one (276 and 163 ms against 45 to 131 ms for the other 22, isolated), paid inside a `beforeAll`. One module-scope line boots and shuts down the first describe's own fixture in each shape, before any hook runs (AGENTS.md: clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading).

**Budget headers (ruling record 6181973363, letter B).** Two files stay over 10 s on CI by the measured ratio here (CI read these three at about 3.5 to 5 times the local file time), and each boots the real stack per fixture: one line at line 2, `// test-budget: N — spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture: REASON`, N = the slowest CI reading x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s.

| file | change | slowest CI reading (s) | budget |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| `src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` | census reuse | 13.60 | none (expected under 10 s) |
| `src/domains/mcp-package-object-discovery.test.ts` | module-scope first boots + header | 14.93 | 20 |
| `src/stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin.test.ts` | header only (its first loads were already paid at module scope) | 16.31 | 30 |

The class follows the precedent `packages/verify/src/held-session-vendor-admin-doors.pin.test.ts` set for one in-process boot followed by per-case door runs.

## Tests

Per-file readings, vitest's own file line (what the refresh lane reads) and process wall, 3 isolated runs each, `--maxWorkers=2`, on a shared 4 vCPU container, before (`bc496bf7`, the three files checked out from the base) and after (`1a5d0aea`):

| file | before r1/r2/r3 (s) | after r1/r2/r3 (s) | wall before / after (s) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| meta-list-projection-parity | 3.58 / 3.10 / 2.96 | 1.50 / 1.37 / 1.40 | 21.1, 20.0, 19.0 / 17.2, 17.5, 17.3 |
| mcp-package-object-discovery | 2.75 / 2.93 / 2.72 | 2.49 / 2.77 / 2.43 | 19.4, 19.5, 18.6 / 18.8, 19.0, 18.3 |
| stored-metadata-reader-contexts.pin | 3.33 / 3.18 / 2.92 | 3.10 / 2.89 / 3.06 | 23.1, 23.4, 21.2 / 22.3, 21.8, 21.3 |

The wall is mostly the package's import graph (transform about 11 s, import about 15 s per isolated run), which collection pays and no clock in the refresh lane reads.

Whole package, both vitest projects, before and after: `local` `Test Files 483 passed (483)`, `Tests 7870 passed | 19 skipped (7889)`; `repo` `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 948 passed (948)`, the same on both sides. Name census over the two JSON reports: 8,834 test names before and after, 0 lost, 0 new, 0 with a changed status.

<details><summary>The reuse proof (one-time, not kept)</summary>

A temporary wrapper made every census read go through both the reused pair and a freshly booted pair, compared the two answers as JSON (status, code, body, items, item and the four headers), and threw on any difference. Run on the after tree: `Tests 879 passed (879)`, 6,136 reads compared, 0 diverged. Reverted before the readings above; `git diff HEAD` was empty after.

</details>

<details><summary>Header parse</summary>

Both lines parse through `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`): budgets 20 and 30 at line 2, class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`; `meta-list-projection-parity` declares none.

</details>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, 188 errors / 68 pinned signatures held, unchanged). No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- The newest reading also lists `domain:server` packages that are not on the card's list: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` (`src/parent-record-read-leaf.integration.test.ts` 35.78 s, `src/comment-parent-pair.integration.test.ts` 28.07 s), `@objectstack/metadata` (`src/serializers/typescript-serializer-annotation.test.ts` 23.74 s), `@objectstack/plugin-pinyin-search` (`src/boot-reconcile.integration.test.ts` 17.47 s), `@objectstack/plugin-security` (16.02, 13.48 s), `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (13.74, 13.38 s). Noted for the card's list; out of this slice.
- `mcp-package-object-discovery` may still read over 10 s on CI after its warm-up (local cut about 8 %), which is why it carries a header; `meta-list-projection-parity` carries none, and the next refresh is the reading that says whether it is under.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-388dl6` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch; claim 6520622267 names it.

## Verification

Local, on `1a5d0aea`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 49 families; each run with its exit captured by redirect before any pipe, plus `pnpm lint`. 48 exit 0 and `pnpm lint` exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (packages outside the runtime closure have no `dist`), NOT MEASURED here and CI's. `--ran`: `49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, exit 0.
